Green = settled (counts for QC); no final state.
A settled procedure stays reactive and can be reopened
A1 rejects a decision not allowed for the task kind (UC-04 matrix).
lastTaskDecided = every ReviewTask of the procedure decided.
not_applicable_pending and interim_completed are not settled (M-04).
periodCovered is set by A1 when the GEN-24 instance linked to the
procedure completes (ASA 330 para 22). GEN-24 is scheduled once its
interim procedure reaches interim_completed; interim_completed itself
is never settled, so the pair cannot wait on each other.
Driven by a persisted timer, independent of the engagement phase;
survives Withdrawn (M-12). Any pending record blocks Gate_RPT01
(Figure 3a). d = GateDecision on the GEN-14 gate.
Each state means "that step is complete". Event-driven by A3, independent of phase.
done is settled, not final: a re-upload creates a new Document version.
